cases.sentence: Сын мой, будь силен в благодати, которую имеем в Иисусе ___.
cases.translation: My son, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location or state requires the prepositional case: в Иисусе Христе.

cases.sentence: То, о чем ты слышал от меня при множестве ___, доверь верным людям.
cases.translation: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit to faithful men.
cases.explain: The genitive множества свидетелей (multitude of witnesses) shows the genitive of quantity after множество.

cases.sentence: Прими свою долю страданий, как добрый ___ Иисуса Христа.
cases.translation: Endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
cases.explain: Добрый воин (good soldier) is a predicate nominative describing Тимофей through the comparative phrase.

cases.sentence: Никакой солдат не связывает себя житейскими ___.
cases.translation: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life.
cases.explain: The verb связывает (entangles) with the reflexive pronoun себя uses the instrumental case for the object.

cases.sentence: Земледелец, который трудится в поле, должен первым получить долю собранного ___.
cases.translation: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
cases.explain: The genitive долю урожая (share of the crops) shows the partitive genitive after доля (portion).

cases.sentence: Помни Иисуса Христа, который был потомком Давида и был воскрешен из мертвых согласно возвещаемой мной радостной ___.
cases.translation: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News.
cases.explain: The preposition согласно (according to) takes the dative or sometimes appears with genitive for compatibility with the underlying relationship.

cases.sentence: Предупреждай их перед Богом, чтобы они не занимались обсуждением бессмысленных ___.
cases.translation: Warn them before God not to engage in disputes over foolish questions.
cases.explain: The genitive plural вопросов is used after the word обсуждением (discussion) in the compound prepositional phrase.

cases.sentence: Старайся представить себя ___ человеком испытанным, работником, которому нечего стыдиться.
cases.translation: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn't need to be ashamed.
cases.explain: The verb представить (to present) with себя takes the dative for the person to whom something is presented: представить себя Богу.

reading.ru: Сын мой, будь силен в благодати, которую имеем в Иисусе Христе.
reading.question: What should Timothy rely on for strength?
options: The grace that is in Christ Jesus
The support of the Roman government
reading.correct: The grace that is in Christ Jesus
reading.explain: Paul tells Timothy: будь силен в благодати (be strengthened in the grace) that is in Christ Jesus.

reading.ru: То, о чем ты слышал от меня при множестве свидетелей, доверь верным людям, которые способны, в свою очередь, учить других.
reading.question: What should Timothy do with the teaching he received?
options: Commit it to faithful people who can teach others
reading.correct: Commit it to faithful people who can teach others
reading.explain: Paul instructs Timothy to commit what he heard to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

reading.ru: Никакой солдат не связывает себя житейскими делами.
reading.question: Why shouldn't a soldier entangle himself in life's affairs?
options: So he can please his commanding officer
reading.correct: So he can please his commanding officer
reading.explain: The verse continues: Для него главное угодить своему командиру (His main goal is to please his commanding officer).

reading.ru: И никакой атлет не получит награды, если будет нарушать правила соревнований.
reading.question: What does the athlete illustration teach about receiving rewards?
options: One must compete by the rules to be crowned
reading.correct: One must compete by the rules to be crowned
reading.explain: The passage illustrates that an athlete can only be crowned if he competes by the rules — implying discipline is required for reward.

reading.ru: Земледелец, который трудится в поле, должен первым получить долю собранного урожая.
reading.question: What reward should the laboring farmer receive?
options: The first share of the crops he worked to gather
reading.correct: The first share of the crops he worked to gather
reading.explain: The farmer who labors is entitled to be the first to partake of the crops.

reading.ru: Помни Иисуса Христа, который был потомком Давида и был воскрешен из мертвых согласно возвещаемой мной радостной вести.
reading.question: What is central to Paul's gospel message about Jesus?
options: Jesus is from David's line and was raised from the dead
Jesus was only a spiritual figure
Jesus is not mentioned in Paul's preaching
reading.correct: Jesus is from David's line and was raised from the dead
reading.explain: Paul reminds Timothy to remember Jesus Christ, descended from David and raised from the dead according to the gospel message Paul proclaims.
